entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū Bakra al-Thaqafī better known as Nufayʿ ibn al-Ḥārith was the half brother of Nafi ibn al-Harith. He is known for his dispute with another Islamic general al-Mughira ibn Shu'ba during a military expedition.
